$schema_note: VATI Industry Integration Architecture stack lock (Rev 2.1 Part E). One canonical choice per layer; overlaps are rejected by trading/tests/test_stack_lock.py. Versions are observations at lock time and are NOT pins: exact pins happen at adoption through the donor gate with Context7/official release facts.

observation_sources.licence_files: raw LICENSE files read from the upstream GitHub repositories 2026-09-16

principles: exactly one production trading kernel; exactly one order sender; exactly one transactional authority store
no component may send a live order unless executes_live_orders is true, and only after a sealed VATI RiskDecision
research, ML, LLM and research-data tools terminate at a signal/model/knowledge boundary
T0 tick-to-order path is in-process; no network broker, workflow engine or LLM sits inside it
licence class COPYLEFT_NETWORK and SOURCE_AVAILABLE require an explicit owner-signed adoption decision
